buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality of Consumables: The bidder must supply only premium, reputed, and nationally established brands that meet standard institutional requirements. The supply of local, unbranded, or substandard clea ning chemicals and tools is strictly prohibited. The buyer reserves the right to reject the entire consignmen t if the supplied items do not meet the expected quality standards. 2. Safety and Chemical Standards: All cleaning chemicals (floor cleaners, glass cleaners, toilet cleaner s, room fresheners, etc.) must be non-toxic, eco-friendly, and safe for institutional use. The products must strictly conform to relevant national/international standard quality certifications and should not cause any harm to the surfaces, flooring, or users. 3. Packaging and Shelf Life: All housekeeping consumables must be delivered in their original, factory- sealed, and tamper-proof packaging. The packaging must clearly display the Manufacturing Date, Expiry D ate, Batch Number, and MRP. Items supplied must be from a fresh manufacturing batch. Any expired, near -expiry, or leaking products will be outrightly rejected and returned at the seller's risk and cost. 4. Replacement of Defective Items: Any items found broken, leaking, defective, or not meeting the req uired BOQ specifications during the physical inspection (CRAC) must be replaced by the supplier within 3 t o 5 working days at their own expense. 5. Right to Reject and Cancel: The Buyer reserves the right to cancel the bid/contract at any stage with out assigning any reason or to reject the supplied goods if they fail to meet the institutional quality and safety standards. .
